description: Author-grouped view of site content. Fetches a pages.json-shaped source (or enhances authored fallback markup, including when the fetch fails) and adds a diacritic-insensitive filter with a polite live result count.

attributes.name: data-lens-src
attributes.description: URL to pages.json (or compatible source). On failure, authored light-DOM markup is kept and enhanced; an empty host shows an error

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Search input placeholder; also the input's accessible name

attributes.name: sort
attributes.description: Group order: alphabetical by author, or by page count (descending, ties alphabetical). Applies to fetched data only

attributes.name: heading-level
attributes.description: Level of the generated "Authors (N)" heading (fetched data only)

childAttributes.name: data-author-group
childAttributes.description: Marks an authored fallback group as filterable; hidden when its visible text does not contain the query
